variants.opcua: OPC UA data change, 1 event per PublishResponse (10 ms publishing interval)
variants.opcua_batch10: OPC UA data change, ~10 events per PublishResponse (100 ms interval, 10 ms spacing)
variants.spb_alias_q0: Sparkplug B DDATA, metric aliases, QoS 0
variants.spb_name_q0: Sparkplug B DDATA, metric names, QoS 0
variants.spb_alias_q1: Sparkplug B DDATA, metric aliases, QoS 1
variants.spb_alias_nots_q0: Sparkplug B DDATA, aliases, no per-metric timestamp, QoS 0

configs.secs_direct: SECS/GEM: equipment -> host (HSMS, S6F11 W-bit, 1 open transaction)
configs.opcua: OPC UA: server -> client subscription (10 ms publishing interval, queue 1000)
configs.mqtt_qos0: MQTT QoS 0 via Mosquitto (Sparkplug B DDATA, aliases)
configs.mqtt_qos1: MQTT QoS 1 via Mosquitto (Sparkplug B DDATA, aliases)
configs.gateway: SECS/GEM -> gateway -> MQTT QoS 1 (S6F12 after PUBACK)
configs.gateway_ack_receipt: SECS/GEM -> gateway -> MQTT QoS 1 (S6F12 on receipt, before PUBACK)
configs.mqtt_qos0_nagle: sensitivity: mqtt_qos0 with Nagle on (paho/Mosquitto default, no TCP_NODELAY)

configs.secs_nospool: SECS/GEM, no spooling (events while not COMMUNICATING are discarded)
configs.secs_spool: SECS/GEM, spooling + S6F23 unload after reconnect

configs.ack_receipt: gateway sends S6F12 as soon as the S6F11 is decoded
configs.ack_puback: gateway sends S6F12 only after the broker's PUBACK (QoS 1)
